WITH __slayer_stage_email_custs AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."campaign_members.customer_id" AS "customer_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      campaign_members.customer_id AS "campaign_members.customer_id"
    FROM campaign_members AS campaign_members
    LEFT JOIN campaigns AS campaigns
      ON campaign_members.campaign_id = campaigns.id
    WHERE
      campaigns.channel = 'email'
    GROUP BY
      campaign_members.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders._count"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
  ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
GROUP BY
  customers__regions.name
ORDER BY
  "orders.customers.regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 21

WITH __slayer_stage_email_custs AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."campaign_members.customer_id" AS "customer_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      campaign_members.customer_id AS "campaign_members.customer_id"
    FROM campaign_members AS campaign_members
    LEFT JOIN campaigns AS campaigns
      ON campaign_members.campaign_id = campaigns.id
    WHERE
      campaigns.channel = 'email'
    GROUP BY
      campaign_members.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders._count"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
  ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
LEFT JOIN __slayer_stage_email_custs AS email_custs
  ON orders.customer_id = email_custs.customer_id
WHERE
  NOT email_custs.customer_id IS NULL
GROUP BY
  customers__regions.name
ORDER BY
  "orders.customers.regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message: South has the highest revenue from email-campaign members at 47,752.93, followed by North (31,994.35), East (24,416.24) and West (24,155.93). Arctic doesn't appear because it has no qualifying orders. An email-campaign member is any customer listed for at least one campaign whose channel is "email". I counted each customer once, even if they joined several email campaigns, so no order is counted twice. Revenue is the sum of order amounts across all order statuses, including both "ok" and "bad" orders.
